amendment_reason: Locked episode, outcome, and past-only baseline semantics before the 05:00 UTC eligible start; signal thresholds and gates were unchanged.
role: risk overlay research, not a standalone alpha and not promotion evidence
hypothesis: A large observable Binance forced-liquidation snapshot shock, normalized by contemporaneous open-interest notional and confirmed by a same-direction mark-price move, identifies a short-lived high-tail-risk state in which suppressing new entries for 30 minutes may reduce adverse excursion.

data.important_limitation: Binance publishes only the latest liquidation order snapshot per symbol within each 1000ms interval. The feed is censored and must never be described as total liquidation volume or a complete event tape.
data.displayed_notional: average price multiplied by accumulated filled quantity in the published snapshot
data.duplicate_rule: identical symbol, side, trade time, original quantity, accumulated quantity, and average price fingerprints are counted once per collector chunk
data.missing_data: never backfill or interpolate; exclude incomplete UTC days

fixed_trigger_for_later_evaluation.sell_snapshot_direction: negative mark return and long-liquidation stress
fixed_trigger_for_later_evaluation.buy_snapshot_direction: positive mark return and short-liquidation stress
fixed_trigger_for_later_evaluation.overlapping_triggers: extend the freeze to 30 minutes after the latest qualifying trigger

fixed_evaluation_contract.episode_start: first qualifying trigger for a symbol outside an existing freeze
fixed_evaluation_contract.episode_extension: a qualifying trigger inside the freeze extends freeze_end but does not create a new sample
fixed_evaluation_contract.outcome: maximum absolute mark-price excursion from episode_start over the next 30 minutes
fixed_evaluation_contract.matched_baseline: same symbol and exact UTC clock time 7 days earlier; if unavailable, try 14, 21, then 28 days earlier
fixed_evaluation_contract.baseline_constraints: past-only, within a complete selected development day, not inside any qualifying freeze, causal mark no more than two seconds old, and complete 30-minute outcome
fixed_evaluation_contract.development_slice: first 60 complete eligible UTC days only; later rows remain unopened
fixed_evaluation_contract.half_split: chronological midpoint of matched non-overlapping development episodes
fixed_evaluation_contract.price_timestamp: exchange event_time_ms; local received_at is retained for latency diagnostics only

locked_validation_contract.opening: requires a current-protocol development PASS report and an immutable SHA-256 lock receipt
locked_validation_contract.validation_start: 00:00 UTC on the calendar day after the lock receipt is created
locked_validation_contract.quarantine: complete days observed after the development slice but before validation_start cannot enter validation
locked_validation_contract.validation_slice: first 30 complete UTC days on or after validation_start
locked_validation_contract.baseline_pool: selected validation days only; development and quarantine days cannot be used as matched baselines
locked_validation_contract.repeat_open: the lock receipt cannot be overwritten or moved
locked_validation_contract.pass_effect: risk-overlay evidence only; never authorizes orders or changes a strategy automatically

prohibited: calling the feed complete liquidation volume
changing thresholds after eligible collection starts
using pre-registration or incomplete-day observations in a gate
turning the overlay into a directional trade without a new preregistration
using the telemetry as strategy profitability or live-promotion evidence
